verdict.rationale: Bruno's own CLI and official Docker images are documented for headless, unattended collection runs in CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions, and they produce JSON/JUnit/HTML reports. That gives a real basis for automated runs without a person at the GUI. However, triggering and scheduling come from the host CI platform, and Bruno AI features (script generation, chat sidebar) are interactive and need review. Missing for 10: a built-in scheduler or monitors for background runs, autonomous agent-driven automations within Bruno, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
